enzgfm_native_bidirectional.baseline: EnzGFM-1.5B, Nature Communications 2026 Supplementary Table S6
enzgfm_native_bidirectional.boundary: Exact official enzyme-similarity archive and standard MAP are aligned, but all 1,573 test reactions are train-seen; this is not reaction-novel evidence. Three exact sequence overlaps in the public split have negligible effect when removed posthoc.

historical_boundary: The older unbounded residual V2 failed one fresh Rhea128->141 promotion. That branch remains an immutable historical audit, but it is not the center of the mainline narrative and was not used to select or evaluate bounded V3.
